page.comment: the page and the canvas behind the dot field

wash.comment: the top of step 0's gradient, which runs down into surface.page (Stage.svelte's .intro-wash)

raised.comment: panels, cards, menus, chips and key caps laid over the page

halo.comment: one layer of --text-halo, the hold-out behind text over the dot field

frost.comment: the plate behind prose laid over a chart (proseOver), blurred through with backdrop-filter so the chart shows faintly behind the words

holdout.comment: the solid rings and glows that part a mark or logo from the field behind it

selection.comment: selected text, a highlighted option, a slider track

border.comment: hairline rules and the edges of controls

shadow.comment: the drop shadow under a popover

scrim.comment: the backdrop behind a modal panel
